newsitem.title: USA: First Years names John Beals CFO.
newsitem.headline: First Years names John Beals CFO.

text.p: First Years Inc said Thursday it appointed John Beals chief financial officer, effective July 1.
The company said the appointment was the result of a split in the current position of Benjamin Peltz, who is senior vice president and treasurer.
Peltz will continue as treasurer. Beals, currently controller and assistant treasurer, will be promoted to vice president-finance and chief financial officer.
Beals will continue as assistant treasurer, First Years said in a press release.
The company was not immediately available to comment on whether Beals will continue as controller, or to comment on the reason for the shift.
